GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , nice trail touch better Mid Field Two Wide 4 Lengths 800m, off heels and presented at the right time soon after Straightening Up but she Just lacked winning dash and only held ground late missing out on placing # Every Chance

bumped on jumping, ended up 3rd last 7 Lengths . Straightened Up 3 Lengths off, momentarily held up, worked Through to finish 2nd (rider - Settled further back than intended due to suffering interference on jumping) # got too far back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped by another runner on jumping away, was taken in and became  awkwardly placed on heels. Momentarily held up for clear running approaching the 200m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went to 2nd Outside Leader . Same to Straightening Up , got upperhand near 100m, grabbed by fresh horse close to the line # 1st had last crack
Jumped Ok raced keenly on ral 3 Lengths from the Leader . Straightened Up 2 Lengths off, was no match for the winner but she Battled On Well enough for 2nd # ok/winner led
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: raced keenly in the middle stages of the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped awkwardly went Through to 5th in between runners 4 Lengths . Straightened Up almost on terms with new Leader , looked a chance but was no match for the horses out wider on the track, tiring Inside 100m # in wrong spot
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: began awkwardly and was slow into stride, then bumped and became awkwardly placed on heels and lost ground. Raced keenly in the middle stages of the event. Laid out near the 600m. Laid out under pressure in the straight.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward led narrowly, laid in on Straightening Up , gave in Quickly (rider reported filly made abnormal respiratory noise in running. trainer - to be freshened & drop back to more suitable trip) # Inconclusive
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: RR that the filly made an abnormal respiratory noise during the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok restrained from gate & Settled back at tail 7 Lengths . Straightened Up 4 Lengths from Leader , didn't run on # never came into it
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Jumped away awkwardly and was slow into stride.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: ( Blinkers 1st Time ) Jumped Ok was trapped Wide early So pressed on & found front going 2 Lengths Clear . Same to Straightening Up , Kept Going Soundly to score # did it both ends!
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped heavily with another runner on jumping away.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , sat Mid Field Two Wide With Cover 6 Lengths 800m, off heels to Middle Of Track Straightening Up and had chance but was only one paced last 200m # one paced
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: raced keenly for a short distance near the 1000m. Laid out  passing the 600m and rounding the home turn. Hampered passing the winning post by a/r, which shifted out when insufficiently clear.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped awkwardly raced bit keenly 4 Lengths from Leader . Straightened Up in Clear , was a big green but she worked to line fairly to just miss 3rd # went ok/1st led
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: raced keenly in the early and middle stages of the event.
